summary: White-label branding + storage quota + MyProjects + ConnectionHelp modal — backend 100% PASS (6/6 pytest), frontend MyProjects page verified (storage RED + upgrade modal + $9/$29 + new-* hrefs OK). ConnectionsPanel HelpModal verified via source-level inspection (URLs/Contents/Workflows match spec) but could not be exercised in headless on /freebuild/chat/{id} due to heavy polling / 403 noise that prevented project view from stabilizing.

integration_issues.issue: Page makes many parallel fetches; some return 403 (auth race) and the component tree doesn't fully render within 7s in a headless browser session. Manual / interactive testing required to fully verify ConnectionsPanel + HelpModal cascade.

action_items: Optional: rate-limit / lazy the heavy polls in FreeBuildChat to make the page testable in headless (currently several parallel fetches fire on mount, some returning 403 before token is read).
Optional: verify ConnectionsPanel + HelpModal cascade interactively (chrome) — code review confirms URLs and required keywords (Contents/Workflows) are present in CONNECTION_GUIDES.
critical_code_review_comments: FreeBuildChat.js is 4489 lines — should be split (ConnectionsPanel, FinalizeModal, CookiesManager, CredentialModal are good extraction candidates).
/api/freebuild-chat/storage/usage cleanly aggregates bytes from current_html, messages, approved_assets, and freebuild_assets — good. quota lookup falls back to TIER_DEFAULTS correctly.

MyProjects.jsx uses dynamic Tailwind class strings like `bg-${m.color}-500/20` — these will NOT be generated by Tailwind JIT unless safelisted. Pills/group cards may render with default styles instead of intended color. Add a safelist to tailwind.config.js for emerald/purple/rose/cyan/pink/blue 500 variants used here, or switch to a static map.
ZenrexBrand: image dimensions are set inline; if /zenrex-logo.png 404s the layout collapses with no fallback — consider a styled fallback Z.
StorageIndicator polls every 60s but does not cancel on logout — minor leak if user signs out without unmounting.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (MyProjects + storage modal + branding verified; HelpModal cascade verified by code review only)

test_credentials: owner@zerax.com / owner123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Use POST /api/auth/login then localStorage.setItem('token', ...) for headless tests — login UI is flaky in headless.
seed_data_creation: Set code_unlocked=true on existing seed app project ba0892c8-6d2a-423a-9bdf-ebe6271bb02a via mongosh to enable open-connections button. No new data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend storage/usage endpoint returns the documented shape and correctly flags owner@zerax.com as over_quota (project_count >> 3). MyProjects page (data-testid='my-projects-page') renders ZenrexBrand + StorageIndicator + filter pills + 3 groups + new-* buttons correctly. The StorageIndicator turns RED with a ترقية pill when needs_upgrade=true and opens storage-upgrade-modal containing storage-upgrade-pro ($9) and storage-upgrade-studio ($29) CTAs both linking to /pricing. ConnectionHelpModal source (/app/frontend/src/components/ConnectionHelpModal.js) contains the correct official URLs (github/settings/personal-access-tokens/new, vercel.com/account/tokens, dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens), Contents+Workflows mentions in GitHub guide, ≥5 numbered steps each, pitfalls section. ConnectionsPanel in FreeBuildChat.js renders 'conn-card-{id}', 'conn-help-{id}' button, 'conn-status-{id}-disconnected/connected' pills, and the helpFor state mounts ConnectionHelpModal. Couldn't exercise the help cascade in headless because /freebuild/chat/{id} page issues many parallel API calls and the testid tree didn't settle within timeouts; recommend interactive QA or extending mount timeout.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs. Single observation: FreeBuildChat top-level component has many parallel fetches on mount; in a fresh headless session some race 403s appear in console before token-bearing requests succeed. This is cosmetic (network noise) and does not affect actual functionality once the page settles, but it makes the page slow to verify with short Playwright timeouts.
